title: A Well for the Cellar
author: Coral Pemberton
blurb: Emrys Crane, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
